Objective: Set up and improve operations

Your objectives

  • Find the right opportunities
  • Enter and grow in Japan or India
  • Turn interest into commitments
  • Set up and improve operations
  • Create new business and sustain value
  • Coordinate complex initiatives

View all services

← Back to all services

Objective

Set up and improve operations

Choose operating arrangements, strengthen existing collaborations and prepare people and organizations to deliver.

Services for this objective

Select an offering to see what it involves.

  • Establish cross-border operations

    Compare operating options, select suitable providers or partners, and coordinate set-up around the capabilities your business needs.

    4 offerings

    • Operating-option comparison
      What we do
      Compare realistic operating routes, including existing domestic options.
      What you receive
      A recommendation with its economics.
      Why this matters
      Choose on business merits rather than a preferred delivery model.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • A Japanese business seeking engineering capability in India

      Discuss this offering

    • Set-up planning and provider selection
      What we do
      Define scope, operating requirements and suitable providers or partners.
      What you receive
      A set-up plan and selected partners.
      Why this matters
      Start with a considered operating arrangement.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • A Japanese business seeking engineering capability in India

      Discuss this offering

    • Transition and ramp-up coordination
      What we do
      Coordinate knowledge transfer, governance and early milestones.
      What you receive
      A ramp-up plan and progress reviews.
      Why this matters
      Support the move from investment to productive work.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • A Japanese business seeking engineering capability in India

      Discuss this offering

    • Early-operations review
      What we do
      Compare initial performance with the intended results.
      What you receive
      An adjustment plan.
      Why this matters
      Address problems before they become established practices.

      Discuss this offering

    Discuss this service

  • Improve existing collaborations

    Diagnose what limits an operation or partnership, then help improve decision-making, working practices and delivery.

    4 offerings

    • Collaboration performance review
      What we do
      Examine decisions, workflow, governance, utilization, rework and retention.
      What you receive
      A diagnosis with priorities.
      Why this matters
      Understand what is limiting performance.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • An existing collaboration delivering less than expected

      Discuss this offering

    • Decision-making and governance redesign
      What we do
      Clarify who decides what, where and how.
      What you receive
      An agreed operating model.
      Why this matters
      Support clearer, more timely decisions.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Changing pricing practices across a global business
      • Improving how a technology organization delivers

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • An existing collaboration delivering less than expected

      Discuss this offering

    • Working-practice improvement
      What we do
      Develop shared practices for acceptance, changes, escalation and communication.
      What you receive
      Agreed working practices for both sides.
      Why this matters
      Address avoidable friction and rework.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • An existing collaboration delivering less than expected

      Discuss this offering

    • Improvement programme
      What we do
      Coordinate changes and measure agreed indicators.
      What you receive
      A tracked programme with regular reports.
      Why this matters
      See whether changes are producing improvement.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Changing pricing practices across a global business
      • Improving how a technology organization delivers

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • An existing collaboration delivering less than expected

      Discuss this offering

    Discuss this service

  • Prepare teams to work together

    Help Japanese and Indian teams understand their responsibilities, prepare for each other’s working expectations and develop the capabilities the assignment requires.

    4 offerings

    • Receiving-team readiness
      What we do
      Prepare the organization receiving cross-border work to specify, review and govern it.
      What you receive
      A readiness plan and supporting practices.
      Why this matters
      Help the organization use the capability effectively.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • Preparing Japanese and Indian teams to work together

      Discuss this offering

    • Professional and language preparation
      What we do
      Design preparation with appropriate training partners.
      What you receive
      A team-readiness programme.
      Why this matters
      Prepare people for the work and interactions ahead.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • Preparing Japanese and Indian teams to work together

      Discuss this offering

    • Talent integration and retention review
      What we do
      Examine why people stay or leave and identify changes.
      What you receive
      A retention plan.
      Why this matters
      Support continuity of skills and knowledge.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • Preparing Japanese and Indian teams to work together

      Discuss this offering

    • Recruitment partner coordination
      What we do
      Coordinate recruitment partners for specified roles, with specialist support.
      What you receive
      A coordinated recruitment process.
      Why this matters
      Support suitable hiring with employment and immigration matters handled by specialists.

      Discuss this offering

    Discuss this service
